## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603275201628645482603256388263049999999997996640490086748910957328658012158594**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-100 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-100), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-100, beta = 1 - 6e-100, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-103 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 58 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-100. Endpoint recertification: native and conservative complex endpoints refined from 1e-70 to 1e-90 (accept at endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-90); native endpoint 6.45e-71 above the old pin; kappa exceeds PR1828 by 6.4548e-71.

Conditional kappa 0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769983114385025802954603275201628645482603256388263049999999997996640490086748910957328658012158594 (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-2e-64, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md).
